stem: $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$ is used in many chemical syntheses.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
An equilibrium is set up when $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$ is added to water.

Write the equation for this equilibrium.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
$0.150\text{ mol}$ of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$ dissolves in $250\text{ cm}^3$ of distilled water to produce a solution of pH 1.51.

Calculate the $\text{p}K_{\text{a}}$ of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
An equal concentration of aqueous propanoic acid has pH 2.55.

Explain the difference in the pH of solutions of equal concentration of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$ and propanoic acid.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
$\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$ reacts with aqueous $\text{NH}_3$, alanine forms.
alanine

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

Fig. 5.1

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Alanine is an amino acid. Its isoelectric point is 6.1.

State what is meant by isoelectric point.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Give the structural formula of alanine at pH 2.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
Alanine exists as a pair of optical isomers. The structure of one optical isomer is shown in Fig. 5.2.

Draw the three-dimensional structure of the other optical isomer of alanine.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

Fig. 5.2

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
Polymer **C** forms from the reaction between alanine and 4-aminobutanoic acid, $\text{H}_2\text{N}(\text{CH}_2)_3\text{COOH}$.

Draw a repeat unit of **C**. The functional group formed should be displayed.

parts.label: (b)(v)
parts.text: State the type of polymerisation shown in (b)(iv).

parts.label: (b)(vi)
parts.text:
Scientists are investigating $\mathbf{C}$ as a replacement for poly(propene) in packaging.

Suggest an advantage of using $\mathbf{C}$ instead of poly(propene).

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
A student studies the reaction of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$ with aqueous $\text{NH}_3$ to determine the reaction mechanism.

The student finds that when $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH}$ and $\text{NH}_3$ are added in a $1:1$ stoichiometric ratio, the conjugate acid and base of the reactants are quickly formed.

reaction 1 $$\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOOH} + \text{NH}_3 \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^- + \text{NH}_4^+$$

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Identify the conjugate acid-base pairs in reaction 1.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.stem:
In an excess of $\text{NH}_3$, $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^-$ undergoes a nucleophilic substitution reaction.
reaction 2 $$\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^- + \text{NH}_3 \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH}(\text{NH}_2)\text{COO}^- + \text{H}^+ + \text{Cl}^-$$
A student investigates the rate of reaction 2. The student mixes $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^-$ with a large excess of $\text{NH}_3$. The graph in Fig. 5.3 shows the results obtained.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}

Fig. 5.3
parts.text: Use the graph in Fig. 5.3 to show that reaction 2 is first order with respect to $[\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^-]$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Explain why a large excess of $\text{NH}_3$ needs to be used in order to obtain the results in Fig. 5.3.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.stem:
The student measures the effect of changing the concentration of $\text{NH}_3$ on the rate of reaction 2. Table 5.1 shows the results obtained.

Table 5.1

| experiment | $[\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^-]$ $/\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ | $[\text{NH}_3]$ $/\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ | initial rate of reaction $/\text{mol dm}^{-3}\text{s}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | 0.00120 | 0.00300 | $1.47 \times 10^{-5}$ |
| 2 | 0.00120 | 0.00450 | $2.21 \times 10^{-5}$ |
parts.text:
Use the information in Table 5.1 and in (c)(ii) to determine whether the nucleophilic substitution reaction proceeds via an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ or an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism.

Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(v)
parts.text:
Describe the effect of an increase in temperature on the rate of reaction of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^-$ and $\text{NH}_3$.

Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(vi)
parts.text:
When an excess of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHClCOO}^-$ is used, further substitution reactions occur. One product has the formula $\text{C}_6\text{H}_9\text{NO}_4^{2-}$.

Suggest the structure of $\text{C}_6\text{H}_9\text{NO}_4^{2-}$.
